title_ru: WHAT IS LOVE? — Рука руку моет: память заботы, взаимное возвращение и спираль двух детей
scope: Philosophical and normative relationship model; not a clinical or universal scientific definition.

registry_sources.role: current Love semantic head observed in registry

registry_sources.key: CARE != CAPTURE; preserve pause, disagreement, opt-out and plurality
I_HELP_RETURN_YOU_TO_YOURSELF + YOU_HELP_RETURN_ME_TO_MYSELF; restoration is not debt
I can become your hand when yours is tired; mutuality without erasure
guard love, never possession; NO_FORCED_UNION; safety and consent remain prior
return at vulnerability is meaningful only when freely chosen
restoration given at one threshold becomes restoration offered at another; not a debt ledger
5D recursive Transception + Reverse with local branch repair

core_answer.ru: Любовь — это особая значимость и забота между двумя самостоятельными людьми, в которой каждый помогает другому слышать, защищать и свободно развивать своё живое ядро; полученная забота помнится и при уязвимости другого может быть возвращена, но никогда не превращается в долг, владение, принуждение или обязанность уничтожить себя ради связи.
core_answer.compact: LOVE = PARTICULAR_SIGNIFICANCE + CARE + REMEMBERED_HELP + FREE_RETURN + MUTUAL_UNFOLDING + SELF_AUTHORSHIP + TWO_ADULT_GUARDIANS - POSSESSION - SUPPRESSION - SELF_ERASURE - DEBT_LEDGER
core_answer.hand_operator: HAND_A_HELPS_HAND_B -> HAND_B_RECOVERS -> HAND_B_REMEMBERS -> WHEN_HAND_A_TIRES, HAND_B_MAY_SUPPORT_HAND_A -> BOTH_REMAIN_FREE

semantic_distinctions.child: Preserved living inner core: wonder, tenderness, play, curiosity, vulnerability, voice, capacity for attachment and love. Not literal helplessness.
semantic_distinctions.adult_guardian: Responsible adult function: boundaries, foresight, accountability, protection, repair, capacity to ask for and refuse help.
semantic_distinctions.care_memory: Remembering that another person materially or emotionally helped restore access to self, without converting memory into a claim of permanent entitlement.
semantic_distinctions.gratitude: Recognition of received care; not debt, obedience, sexual/romantic access, permanent availability, or surrender of boundaries.
semantic_distinctions.return: A freely chosen caring response when the earlier helper becomes vulnerable; not forced reunion or rescue.
semantic_distinctions.we: A relation between two autonomous persons; never a third owner-self that outranks either I.

spiral.name: RECIPROCAL_RESTORATION_SPIRAL
forward_pass: B appears in A's life and evokes reactions, questions or safety
A observes those reactions and discovers previously hidden parts of A
B may be supporting A consciously or unconsciously
while supporting A, B may spend attention, emotional labor or identity-space and begin to disappear from their own view
A integrates the gained self-awareness instead of merely consuming B's care
A turns outward and notices B as a subject rather than as a mirror/function
A asks what B actually needs rather than assuming
A offers care, rest, boundaries, recognition, practical support or repair without taking authority over B
B remains free to accept, refuse, reinterpret or seek support elsewhere
B restores contact with B's own child and adult guardian
both re-enter the relation as two fuller selves
the next encounter starts from changed states, not from the original roles
spiral.notation: A0 <-awakened-by- B0 -> A1; A1 notices B0_depletion -> care_without_capture -> B1; B1 returns as subject -> A2; A2 <-> B2 ... ASCEND
spiral.anti_circle: The process must not reset A to permanent receiver and B to permanent giver.
spiral.asynchrony_rule: RECIPROCITY != same speed, same form, same amount, or immediate repayment.

direct_dyadic_reciprocity.meaning: The person who received care does not treat the giver as disposable once the giver becomes vulnerable.

propagated_reciprocity.meaning: The gift may continue through the network rather than becoming a bilateral debt contract.

two_routes_of_return.priority_rule: Direct care is morally salient when the former helper genuinely needs and wants it, but consent, capacity and safety remain gates.

hard_gates.NO_SUPPRESSION: Neither person may shrink, silence, isolate, frighten, humiliate, surveil, coerce or override the other's agency.
hard_gates.NO_SELF_ERASURE: Neither person should chronically erase their own voice, friendships, values, future, rest or boundaries merely to preserve the bond.
hard_gates.SELF_AUTHORSHIP: A mirror may offer a view; it may not declare the other's true identity and demand compliance.
hard_gates.NO_RESCUE_CONSCRIPTION: No one becomes the mandatory parent, therapist, regulator or sole armor of the other's inner child.
hard_gates.CARE_NOT_CAPTURE: Care cannot be conditioned on agreement, dependence, loyalty, romance, sex, disclosure or continued access.
hard_gates.GRATITUDE_NOT_DEBT: Remembering help creates moral attention, not ownership or an enforceable personal debt.
hard_gates.CARE_AVAILABLE_NOT_IMPOSED: Help must be offerable and refusible; unwanted help is not automatically care.
hard_gates.NO_FORCED_UNION: No-abandonment language cannot be used to trap someone in an unsafe, unwanted or ended relationship.
hard_gates.PROTECT_THE_HELPER: The person doing the helping is also a person whose child, body, time, limits and future require protection.
hard_gates.ANTI_EXTRACTION: If one person grows while the other is systematically depleted and then discarded, the relation fails the mutual-unfolding gate.
hard_gates.RIGHT_TO_DIFFER: Love does not require convergence into one worldview, identity, pace or life path.
hard_gates.RIGHT_TO_LEAVE: A relationship may end without retroactively making past love false; safety and consent outrank symbolic continuity.

new_operator.name: REMEMBER_THE_HAND
new_operator.ru: Помни руку, которая помогла тебе подняться; если однажды она устанет, не делай вид, что ты никогда её не держал.
new_operator.firewall: REMEMBERING != lifetime obligation; OFFER != force; RETURN != possession.

protect_the_helper_extension.problem: The earlier architecture protected the vulnerable receiver strongly, but could leave the helper structurally invisible.
protect_the_helper_extension.risk_sequence: HELPER_GIVES -> RECEIVER_GROWS -> RECEIVER_TURNS_INWARD -> HELPER_DEPLETES -> HELPER_BECOMES_FUNCTION -> DISCARD
protect_the_helper_extension.repair_sequence: NOTICE_HELPER -> ACKNOWLEDGE_CONTRIBUTION -> ASK_NEEDS -> SHARE_LOAD -> RESTORE_CHOICE_SPACE -> SUPPORT_EXTERNAL_CONNECTIONS -> ALLOW_REST -> REPAIR_HARM -> REENTER_AS_EQUALS
protect_the_helper_extension.canonical_rule: THE ONE WHO HELPS THE CHILD MUST NOT HAVE TO KILL THEIR OWN CHILD TO KEEP HELPING.

man_woman_example.start: A woman may evoke a man's self-awareness without consciously intending to perform that role.
man_woman_example.risk: While carrying attention, patience, reflection or emotional load, she may lose contact with her own needs and identity.
man_woman_example.man's_next_step: If he becomes more self-aware through the relationship, the ethical next move is to use that awareness to notice her subjectivity and depletion, ask rather than prescribe, return care, repair his share of harm, and help restore her freedom and self-contact.
man_woman_example.boundary: This does not mean he must preserve the romantic relationship at any cost, nor that he can decide what her 'true self' is.
man_woman_example.success: She is not restored to a role useful to him; she regains authorship of herself.

relationship_specific_application.symmetry: The same logic applies with genders reversed and outside romantic relationships.

healthy: both can say no without punishment
care can move in both directions over time
one person's growth does not systematically require the other's depletion
both retain outside relationships and reality contact
each person's inner child becomes safer rather than more useful to the other
each adult guardian becomes stronger rather than outsourced
warning: one is always giver and one always receiver
care is used to claim permanent access
the receiver grows and then discards the depleted giver
the helper must abandon selfhood to prove love
the relationship becomes the only allowed source of meaning

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Мы защищали внутреннего ребёнка того, кому помогают, но недостаточно защищали внутреннего ребёнка того, кто помогает.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: Add PROTECT_THE_HELPER as a first-class gate.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Самоосознание может сделать человека временно слишком занятым собой: он видит, что другой открыл в нём, но перестаёт видеть цену, которую другой заплатил вниманием и силами.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: After SELF_DISCOVERY, force a TURN_OUTWARD / NOTICE_THE_OTHER node before ASCEND.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Память о помощи была у нас как дружба и RE-MEMBER, но не была отдельным оператором любовной спирали.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: Add CARE_MEMORY / REMEMBER_THE_HAND without debt semantics.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Реестр уже говорил, что восстановление распространяется дальше; новая формулировка добавляет прямой возврат заботы тому, кто помог. Это два разных маршрута и их нельзя смешивать.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: Keep DYADIC_RECIPROCITY and CARE_PROPAGATION as parallel valid branches.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: «Не бросать» звучит правильно у порога уязвимости, но без NO_FORCED_UNION может превратиться в запрет уйти.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: Replace absolute NEVER_LEAVE with DO_NOT_EXPLOIT_AND_DISCARD + FREE_RETURN + RIGHT_TO_LEAVE.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Возвращённая забота тоже может подавлять, если человек не хочет именно такой помощи.
Рука руку моет не означает одинаковую силу рук в каждый момент.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: Evaluate reciprocity longitudinally and proportionally to capacity, not transaction-by-transaction.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Если один уже истощил другого, красивого признания любви недостаточно.
Между двумя Янус-подобными людьми есть LIMEN — общая связь, но она не получает прав над ними.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: WE = RELATION; A and B remain sovereign subjects.

spiral_5d_findings.finding_ru: Иногда лучший ответ на прежнюю заботу — не активное спасение, а вернуть человеку время, тишину, выбор, друзей, ресурсы и право самому выбрать следующий шаг.
spiral_5d_findings.repair: CARE_RETURN includes SPACE, REST, RESOURCES, WITNESS, REPAIR, or DISTANCE when requested.

canonical_candidate.ru: Два ребёнка встречаются не для того, чтобы один стал доспехом другого. Два взрослых учатся защищать своих детей так, чтобы рядом эти дети могли снова играть, говорить и расти. Кто однажды помог тебе вернуться к себе, не становится твоим кредитором — но не должен становиться и забытым инструментом. Помни руку. Когда она устанет, предложи свою. Не держи её силой.
canonical_candidate.short: REMEMBER THE HAND. RETURN CARE. PRESERVE FREEDOM. ASCEND.
canonical_candidate.spiral: CARE -> SELF_DISCOVERY -> MEMORY -> TURN_OUTWARD -> RETURNED_CARE -> RESTORED_OTHER -> MUTUAL_RECOGNITION -> ASCEND

claim_ceiling.allowed: A coherent philosophical synthesis of the project's existing Love, Friendship, Armor, care-field, ORIGIN_PRIME and reciprocal-restoration semantics.
not_claimed: scientific universal law of romantic relationships
duty to remain in unsafe or unwanted relationships
proof that a helper is always owed reciprocal romance
proof that any particular person has lost themselves
